news.headline: Fire destroys historic French market of Enfants-Rouges in Paris
news.summary: The historic Marché des Enfants-Rouges in central Paris was gutted by fire early on Monday. The market in the Marais neighbourhood is the oldest covered market in the French capital, dating back to 1615, and is also a listed building.
